It has happened with me that once i prayed salat and later realized after finishing my salat that in the surah fatiha i missed to recite one particular line (siratal mustakeem). And that to i am not sure but i think i have missed. Because I dint realize in salat i didnt even did sajdah sahu .Also i am confused about it whether I read it or not . Please tell me what should i do in this situation. When some one is confused whether he has missed an arkan of salat . I know I dint missed my fard part of my salat . as reading fatiha is wajib 2. It has happened with me that some time i see spot of mazi in my under garment , less than the size of dirham , but issue is that i go to work and i pray my zuhar and asir salah at work and before salat i normally make wadhu but some time because i know that my wadhu is not broken i dont make wadhu again if i have already got my wadhu since zuhar and i pray Asir with the same wadhu . Once it happened when i cam back home i saw the sign of impurity in my under garment . Now i am confused whether my wadhu was broken after zuhar and i didnt knew about it or i got this impurity after the asir salat because I come back home riding bicycle and some time I get some mazi due riding bike . And i was really worried because i came to know about it when i went to toilet at the time of maghrib , due to confusion I repeated my asir salat with qaza neyat , but can you please tell me the way to overcome these doubts . 3. what should I do when I have doubt in my mind , it appears to be shaitan has constantly bringing doubt about my salat making me feel guilty whether I have performed my salat properly or not . answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 12665 Country: Canada Title: When performing salaah in a sitting position, is it better to sit on a chair or a flat surface such as the floor? Question: When performing salaah in a sitting position, is it better to sit on a chair or a flat surface such as the floor? Answer ID: 12665 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 705/521=L/1430) It is better to perform salah sitting on ground. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
